text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Satono Diamond and Satono Crown 
took part in an outdoor recreation event 
organized by a nursing home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—How is it? This Chinese tea smells 
wonderful, don't you think? Please teach 
me how to brew delicious Japanese tea 
later too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you all! I will do my 
absolute best during today's recreation 
activities.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you particularly enjoy 
doing? If it's alright with you, I would 
love to spend time together doing it.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
...Then show me some running. Let's see... 
Go run about 5 laps around the outside of 
the park for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood! Well then—here I go!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Ah! That old man is doing it again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eh? What do you mean by "again"?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Whenever outsiders come by, he always 
makes up random chores like that just to 
be mean to them. He's truly a difficult 
old fellow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but don't worry. Knowing our Dia—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mister! I finished all 5 laps, just as you 
requested!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A-Already? I see. My bad, though, I 
went to the restroom and missed it 
completely. How about another 5 laps?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood! Off I go, then!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, fell asleep this time around. Give 
me another—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, I will run another 10 
laps or so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I'm back! How was that? My body warmed up 
nicely, so I believe I put on a good run—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, that's not what I meant at all! 
...You're a Satono horse girl, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell are you playing along with 
such blatant harassment? You ought to just 
head back and do some training or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Fufufu, thank you for your 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, please do not worry. I will 
deliver results without fail, both in 
official races—and in my running here.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Running here? What are you babbling 
about—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
After all, running to meet everyone's 
expectations is the pride of Satono—and 
fulfilling the hopes entrusted to me is my 
mission.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How was it? Did I manage to fulfill your 
wishes?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's still not enough. So to make 
up for what's missing, I'll go to the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mister... does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Show it to me there—that pride you stake 
on racing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! I swear to show it to you without 
fail, in the form of victory!
